commit_title: Add exponential/logarithmic mapping and clamp exponent
commit_message: Introduce new mapping types (exponential, logarithmic) across the style store, UI and plot helpers, and clamp computed exponent k to the 1..20 range. Updated useStyleSideMenuStore type to include the new mapping options. StyleElementSettings: add new select options (exponential, logarithmic, legacy curve), compute pct for exponential and logarithmic mappings (logarithmic uses the inverse exponent), show an equation/info box and update midpoint/anchor table rendering. PlotlyHelpers and internal mapping logic now handle the new types and clamp k to avoid extreme powers. Also propagate absorbedPoint from the ink ratio store into the data pipeline call in PlotAreaControlButtons.
